question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

To huff and puff

options.text: To breathe heavily or rapidly because one is exhausted

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to huff and puff"** means:

 
 
• To breathe heavily and with difficulty, typically because of **exertion**. (थकान या मेहनत के कारण भारी और कठिनाई से सांस लेना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** After running up the hill, he was **huffing and puffing.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To be perplexed** (उलझन में होना): To be confused or puzzled.

 
 
• **Example:** She was perplexed by the complex instructions given to her.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To get into trouble** (परेशानी में पड़ना): To encounter difficulties or problems.
 
 
• **Example:** If you break the rules, you will get into trouble.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To speak ill of** (बुरा बोलना): To talk negatively about someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** It is not good to speak ill of others behind their backs.
 
 

3a:Tbd4,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
